verdict.rationale: Medusa's pricing page lists a 'Cloud Development Agent' as an enterprise feature, hinting at some built-in AI assistant capability, but there's no documentation describing what it does, how a user delegates tasks to it, or how it's used within the product UI. The rest of the AI-related evidence (MCP server, 'guardrails for agents') is about external AI coding agents building customizations or IDE tools connecting to docs, not a built-in in-product assistant for end users. Missing for 10: documentation/screenshots of the Cloud Development Agent's actual task-delegation workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation it exists and works, and clarity on how it differs from the developer-facing MCP/CLI tooling.
